title: Voter Helpline MP 1950
eligibility: Voters and prospective voters in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Check name in voter list, polling booth locations, and EPIC card delivery status
File voter registration or election-related complaints
documents_required: EPIC (Voter ID) Number or Aadhaar Number
application_process: Step 1: Dial 1950 with your STD code
Step 2: Provide EPIC number to check polling station or application status
